objects.name: Analytic 2173
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies exploit-pattern HTTP/HTTPS traffic targeting an ICS DMZ application from a source or request pattern outside the approved application baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: netflow:ipfix
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: IPFIX/NetFlow flow record (src/dst IP, src/dst port, protocol, packets/bytes/time): inbound exploit-pattern traffic to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) server followed by outbound connection from same Internet Protocol (IP) address to internal ICS network

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: IP ranges from which legitimate access to the ICS web interface is expected.
Regex/signature set for known exploit payload patterns and published CVE-specific payload signatures for in-use ICS web products.
Time window within which a child shell process spawned from the web server is considered connected to a preceding exploit-pattern request.
